  PROBLEM: A github-actions[bot] entry comment whose ai-comment-sig:v1 marker is not the final line is neither verified nor counted as unverified. A signed entry comment edited with text appended after the signature fails the HMAC, but it also fails `_is_signed_bot_comment`. So `_verify_signed_entry_comments`, `_authoritative_entry_comments` (line 669) and `_unverified_entry_keys` (line 528) all skip it, and no `op=verify outcome=unverified` line is emitted.
  WHY: resolve computes the unverified set as empty for this comment. The close decision at lines 977-981 can then close the tracker, which defeats the fail-closed `unverified_signed_entries` guarantee. This contradicts the code comment at lines 454-455 that says anything that looks signed is unverifiable, not unsigned. The reviewer labelled this SEVERITY: MAJOR. Suggested fix: detect any github-actions[bot] comment containing the marker anywhere in the body.
